scope: Fresh native Windows editor and workers; private 30-second compound project with supplied 4K AV1/PQ/AAC media, 480x270 child/root canvases; ordinary editor window
installed_root_observation: After installing the accepted payload, a fresh root process with fresh workers opens a private copy at frame zero. Source and program show the beach picture, timecode/playhead are zero, and compound filmstrip bitmaps render.
observations: Initial frame zero is visible in both source and program monitors; compound filmstrip renders.
Program Play advances picture and timecode; stereo output meters respond and Audio playing is displayed.
Stop clears output meters and displays Stopped / silent.
Program rewind returns to visible beach frame at 00:00:00:00.
Timeline Fit displays the complete 30-second compound filmstrip.
Paused distant ruler seek displays 00:00:12:41 in program timecode and bottom playhead status, moves the timeline marker, and displays a sloth picture.
Histogram, RGB parade and luma waveform change from the beach image to the sought picture; scopes display sampled 21600 px of 480x270.
limits: These observations do not establish native-resolution 4K fullscreen or sustained 60fps playback.
Exact thumbnail pixel/time alignment is covered by the independent asynchronous bitmap gate rather than inferred from coarse filmstrip spacing.
